title: Plectic Heegner classes
summary: We introduce a new collection of partially global Galois cohomology classes subsuming both plectic Heegner points and mock plectic invariants. The former are recovered as localizations of plectic Heegner classes, while the latter arise as eigenspace projections with respect to a "partial Frobenius"-action. By overcoming some limitations of previous constructions, plectic Heegner classes are expected to provide finer control over the arithmetic of higher rank elliptic curves.
